recommendation.summary: S5 FD-passing process handoff with identity state transfer (new binary).
justification: the change is interface-level but not S6-patchable (github.com/go-chi/chi/v5/middleware.WrapResponseWriter: interface method set changed (itabs and type assertions are compiled in); github.com/go-chi/chi/v5/middleware.basicWriter: layout of compiled-in type basicWriter changed (1 functions use it); S6 replaces functions, not types); state schema is unchanged, so S5 with identity transfer is the cheapest safe choice

S6 blockers (2): github.com/go-chi/chi/v5/middleware.WrapResponseWriter: interface method set changed (itabs and type assertions are compiled in); github.com/go-chi/chi/v5/middleware.basicWriter: layout of compiled-in type basicWriter changed (1 functions use it); S6 replaces functions, not types
alternatives: Kubernetes rolling update (loses in-memory state, needs surge capacity)
risks: changed functions are small enough to be inlined; with S6 slot trampolines the call still dispatches through the slot, but raw binary patching (internal/livepatch) must also patch the inlining callers: github.com/go-chi/chi/v5/middleware.basicWriter.maybeWriteHeader
no patched function has a context.Context parameter: S6 gives per-call (not per-request) consistency, so one request may mix old and new versions of the 3 functions
